Dean Roy

Freedom and Unity candidate for Governor, Vermont · Challenger

High school student at Stowe High School; former Vermont legislative page

Dean Roy is a high school student from Stowe, Vermont, who is running for governor in 2026 at age 14. He created his own minor party, the Freedom and Unity party, to get onto the general election ballot. The Associated Press reported that he is the first Vermont candidate for governor under age 18 to appear on a general election ballot. The state constitution sets no minimum age for governor.

Where Roy stands

Affordability and cost of living (housing)
Says housing is the most important issue facing Vermont.
Affordability and cost of living
Says Vermont has a housing and affordability crisis. He argues the problem is clear when even children in the state can see it.
Relationship with national Republican Party
Says he does not identify with either major party.

Background

  • Born and raised in Stowe, Vermont
  • Served as a legislative page at the Vermont Statehouse (2025)
  • Student at Stowe High School (freshman in the 2025–26 school year)
  • Founded the Freedom and Unity party to qualify for the 2026 general election ballot
  • Has not held elected office

Also running for Governor

  • June Goodband Peace and Justice
  • Amanda Janoo Democratic/Progressive
  • Brian Judd Independent
  • Phil Scott Republican
